categories.main_business_segments: Tanseisha operates three main business segments: Commercial and Other Facilities (including department stores, specialty stores, restaurants, offices, hotels, and exhibitions), Chain Store Facilities (interior work for chain-type stores such as fast fashion and fast food), and Cultural Facilities (museums, science centers, and other cultural spaces). The group also engages in related services such as office equipment rental/sales, staffing, and web-based information services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in comprehensive display solutions, integrating research, planning, design, construction, and project management for spatial environments. It leverages advanced digital technologies such as BIM, sustainable design and construction methods, and collaborates with partners for co-creation and prototyping of new spatial experiences. Emphasis is placed on environmental design, universal design, and safety management throughout the production process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tanseisha serves a wide range of clients, including commercial facility operators (department stores, specialty retailers, restaurants), chain store operators (fast fashion, fast food, convenience stores), and public sector or cultural institutions (museums, science centers, government agencies). The company also targets offices, hotels, and event organizers, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Japan, with offices and subsidiaries in major cities such as Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, and Fukuoka. Overseas activities have included a presence in China (Shanghai), but as of 2025, the Chinese subsidiary has been divested. Over 90% of sales and assets are concentrated in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tanseisha operates as a midstream and downstream player in the supply chain, acting as a prime contractor for spatial design and construction projects. It manages the entire process from planning to delivery, coordinating with upstream suppliers (materials, equipment) and downstream partners (subcontractors, service providers).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the business foundation (workstyle reform, digitalization, supply chain resilience), expanding into new business domains, and enhancing sustainability initiatives. R&D focuses on integrating new technologies and market-driven solutions for spatial experiences, with active collaboration and prototyping. The company is committed to sustainability, diversity, and innovation, aiming to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and develop sustainable solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based contracts for spatial design, construction, and related services. The company recognizes revenue over the duration of projects based on progress, with additional income from equipment rental, staffing, and web-based information services. There is no significant recurring revenue component.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese display and spatial design firms such as Nomura Co., Ltd. and Space Co., Ltd. Tanseisha is positioned as one of the leading companies in the Japanese display and spatial design industry, with a strong reputation for comprehensive project management and high-value-added solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending January 2025, consolidated net sales reached approximately 91.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.1 billion yen and net income attributable to shareholders of 3.9 billion yen. The company has shown strong recovery and growth, with sales and profits increasing over the past two years, and a workforce of nearly 1,500 employees. The medium-term plan targets further growth and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tanseisha differentiates itself through its ability to deliver emotionally engaging, high-quality spatial experiences that combine creativity, advanced technology, and sustainability. The company emphasizes its comprehensive, end-to-end project capabilities, deep expertise in both commercial and cultural spaces, and its commitment to co-creation with clients and partners. Its focus on sustainable, innovative, and human-centered design is a key part of its value proposition.
